title: Revision
description: Appended correction, exclusion or processing-level advance against an original observation (technical specification 'Revision' row and the example correction contract). Revisions never overwrite earlier revisions; each carries the base revision it builds on so concurrent editors receive a conflict instead of silent overwrite (If-Match optimistic version). Exclusions are tombstones that retain provenance; physical deletion requires a separately ratified retention rule.

id.description: Revision identifier; also the basis of the If-Match ETag (e.g. "revision-7").

baseRevisionId.description: Revision this one builds on; null when it is the first revision of the observation.

type.description: correction replaces the value, exclusion tombstones the point (value null), level-advance re-states the value at a higher processing level.

value.description: Replacement value in unitId; null for exclusions.

processingLevel.description: Governed level this revision asserts. A reviewed value is not automatically public.

qualifierIds.description: Governed qualifier identifiers (e.g. ice-affected, interpolate). Multiple qualifiers are allowed.

reason.description: Required justification. Redacted from public projections of revision history when internal.

actorId.description: Acting principal, always derived from the session/token server-side, never from a body field.

recordedAt.description: UTC instant the revision was recorded; distinct from the observation time.

idempotencyKey.description: Client idempotency key; replaying the same key with a different body is rejected.
